## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run verify`
- [ ] Public behavior and types are documented.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is updated or `skip-changelog` is justified.
- [ ] No private device identifiers, credentials, generated artifacts, or unrelated changes are included.

## Sources

Link factual catalog sources when this change affects device or OS build data.
